title: stripe-node Verified Webhooks With an Empty Key
caption:
My webhook secret has been an empty string in staging for who knows how long.

stripe-node 22.6.2 landed September 9 with one new check: throw if the secret is empty. Before that, an empty string went straight into crypto.createHmac and the signature check ran against a key anyone can compute. An undefined secret would have crashed the handler. A blank line in .env just kept going.

The part I keep thinking about: real Stripe events fail loudly in that state, so you notice within a day. A forged one wouldn't.

Checked yours lately?

slides.headline:
Empty Secret,
Valid Signature
slides.sub: stripe-node checked webhook signatures against an empty HMAC key until 22.6.2, published September 9.

slides.title: Blank Is Not Missing
slides.sub: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET= in .env parses to "". An undefined secret throws ERR_INVALID_ARG_TYPE. An empty string hashes fine.

slides.title: Then The Check Inverts
items: HMAC-SHA256 with an empty key is public. Anyone can compute it.
Real Stripe events fail. The signature never matches.
A forged event passes. Same empty key, same digest.
Default tolerance is 300s. A fresh timestamp clears it.

slides.title: 22.6.2 Throws Instead
slides.sub: Published September 9: “No webhook secret value was provided. It should start with whsec_.”

slides.headline: Is Yours Actually Set?
slides.sub: and I’ll send the one-line guard
